messages:
rachel_marketing: Heads-up — Riverfront DevJam is Friday. We need final decisions on: speaker lineup, benchmark one-pager for the booth, swag corrections (tee sizes), and the webinar follow-up cadence. Can each owner call out what they can close today?

sam_events: I can lock logistics and vendor pickup. Tablecloth + pop-up banner arriving Thu. Need final booth footprint from venue by Wed noon.

tariq_growth: I'll own the webinar nurture + launch post copy. Want the benchmark bullets by EOD so I can draft email + event social. Also can set the nurture to 3 touches: immediate benchmark, webinar invite (2x reminders), and a demo booking CTA.

maria_design: Working on the benchmark one-pager now. Will include a small chart (median p95 latency vs public inference) + cost-per-1k tokens callout. Uploading draft v1 in 2 hours.

jin_sales: Lead routing: QR -> Typeform short form -> Zapier -> HubSpot. Prefer we add a hidden field "event=Riverfront" and a multi-select "interest: hosted,dedicated,private". Triage: immediate hot leads flagged for SDRs.

rachel_marketing: Great. Swag update: ordered 150 shirts but printing flagged sizes small S and XL shortage. We can either: 1) expedite extra prints (cost +$300) or 2) increase sticker/pin counts and explain sizes on signup for swag mail later. Thoughts?

maria_design: If we push expedited print, need final art in 3 hours. I can tweak mock for print with same art but different ink weight to speed production.

sam_events: Venue allows shipping direct to dock. Courier cutoff Thu 5pm. If we expedite shirts, courier needs tracking by Thu 11am.

tariq_growth: For messaging, I prefer option 2 (no panic). Offer a postcard voucher on signup: "Claim your tee size" so we capture address and fulfill after. Keeps costs down and gives us data. We can A/B test the voucher copy in the form.

jin_sales: Agree with voucher. Also add checkbox: "send benchmark + webinar invite" so ops knows who to nurture.

rachel_marketing: OK voucher flow then. @jin_sales can you add the hidden field and checkbox? Also add property lead_source=devjam_riverfront.

jin_sales: Will post the Typeform link + Zapier mapping by EOD. Example payload snippet for HubSpot (sample):
```
POST /hubspot/v1/contacts
{
  "properties": [
    {"property": "email", "value": "{{email}}"},
    {"property": "company", "value": "{{company}}"},
    {"property": "event", "value": "devjam_riverfront"},
    {"property": "interest", "value": "{{interest}}"}
  ]
}
```

maria_design: Uploaded benchmark_v1.pdf: https://drive.redwood/riverfront/benchmark_v1.pdf. It highlights: 1) 2-3x lower per-token cost with batching strategies, 2) median p95 latency <150ms on our dedicated configs, 3) KV-cache prefix reuse cut token compute by ~30%. Need numbers verified by infra.

rachel_marketing: @sam_events ping infra for quick number check — @infra (cc) is offline here but we need sign-off. If numbers change, update doc and Tariq will tweak messaging.

sam_events: I pinged infra slack channel and left a note. Ops bot: can you add a reminder for infra sign-off Wed 10am?

ops_bot: Reminder set: notify #eng-infra Wed 10:00 UTC for benchmark verification.

tariq_growth: Webinar plan: host a 30-minute panel 1 week post-event. Speakers: Sam (ops), Lina (research), and Tariq for product narrative. Call-to-action on the bench one-pager: "Join follow-up webinar — limited seats" with a UTMs link.

maria_design: I'll add the CTA/button to the one-pager and the postcard art. Also creating a small QR card (2.5x3.5) with short URL and QR.

rachel_marketing: Photographer? We budgeted for 45 min on-site. Sam, can you confirm timing so we have a clean hero shot?

sam_events: Recommend shoot at 9:15am during setup finish. I'll add to venue schedule and block a 30-min window.

jin_sales: Quick question on triage: hot lead = requested demo or selected "hosted/dedicated" and company size >50? We should encode triggers in Zapier.

tariq_growth: Hot lead rule: selected "book demo" OR selected dedicated/private AND company_size >= 50 employees OR selected "urgent reachout" checkbox. Jin, can you encode and add a Slack webhook to #sdr-inbox for hot leads?

jin_sales: Will add Slack webhook. Posting mapping and test payload later.

rachel_marketing: Final checklist owners: swag + vouchers: @rachel_marketing, vendor + shipping: @sam_events, benchmark + postcard: @maria_design, webinar + nurture copy: @tariq_growth, lead routing + Zapier: @jin_sales.

sam_events: I'll confirm courier pickup Thu 10:30 and post tracking. Also reserving a backup pop-up table in case setup area shifts.

maria_design: Final note: need brand-approved phrasing for benchmark claims. Adding a small legal blurb: "Benchmarks are for typical workloads; your mileage may vary".

tariq_growth: I'll draft 2 headline options for the launch post: 1) "Lower cost, predictable inference at scale" and 2) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost". Will iterate on tone based on benchmark numbers.

jin_sales: Typeform link (draft): https://typeform.com/to/river123 (test mode). Adding webhook mapping in thread when ready.

ops_bot: Policy reminder: Any onsite demo with real customer data requires approval from security 48hrs prior.

rachel_marketing: Thanks team. If no blockers, we'll reconvene tomorrow at 10am to close loops. :rocket:
